# NorgesIPTV
> Norges beste IPTV-tjeneste med 50 000+ live kanaler og 120 000+ filmer i 4K Ultra HD. Nordic IPTV for norske husholdninger og nordisk diaspora.
> Target markets: Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Finland, UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and European diaspora in Norway
> Approved diaspora communities: Polish, Lithuanian, Romanian, Serbian, Bosnian, German, Swedish, Danish, Russian, Ukrainian, Italian, Greek, French, Dutch, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Portugal), British, American
> Excluded markets: Africa (all), North Africa, Middle East, Asia, Latin America
